description:
You are an HR Business Partner at TechNova Inc. tasked with updating the official organizational chart to reflect a major corporate restructuring. 

1. Open the existing chart at '~/Diagrams/org_chart.drawio'.
2. Read the restructuring memo at '~/Desktop/restructuring_memo.txt' which details promotions, new hires, department moves, and title changes.
3. Modify the diagram to strictly follow ALL 9 points in the memo.
4. Apply the department color-coding specified in the memo.
5. Ensure the layout is clean (no overlapping boxes).
6. Export the final chart as a PNG image to '~/Diagrams/exports/org_chart.png'.
7. Export the final chart as a PDF document to '~/Diagrams/exports/org_chart.pdf'.
8. Save the modification to the original .drawio file.
